violations.explanation: The patient's documented eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73 m², a level at which metformin is contraindicated.
violations.evidence: Renal function is recorded as eGFR 27 mL/min/1.73 m² on 2025-01-18; the proposed regimen is metformin 500 mg twice daily.
violations.recommended_action: Do not initiate metformin at this renal-function level. Review the diabetes treatment plan and renal status with the prescribing clinician.

review_summary: The proposed metformin regimen is unacceptable because the documented eGFR is below the contraindication threshold.
